# GateXPay

> GateXPay provides enterprise payment infrastructure, payment gateway integration, digital banking solutions, and secure financial technology services for businesses, fintechs, and financial institutions.

## Overview
- [Home](https://gatexpay.com/): Official GateXPay homepage and enterprise payment solutions.
- [About Us](https://gatexpay.com/about): GateXPay company overview, mission, leadership, and fintech ecosystem.
- [Contact Us](https://gatexpay.com/contact): Connect with sales, support, and integration experts.
- [All Services](https://gatexpay.com/services): Explore complete catalog of 26+ fintech and enterprise services.

## Core Financial & Payment Services
- [Payment Gateway Integration](https://gatexpay.com/services/payment-gateway-integration): Secure multi-mode checkout, UPI, cards, net banking, wallets, and payment APIs.
- [Core Banking Solutions](https://gatexpay.com/services/core-banking-solutions): Scalable digital banking infrastructure, ledger management, and financial accounts.
- [Loan & Credit Integration Services](https://gatexpay.com/services/loan-insurance-services): Digital lending journeys, loan origination, credit assessment, and repayment workflows.
- [AePS Services](https://gatexpay.com/services/aeps-services): Aadhaar-enabled biometric cash withdrawal, balance enquiry, and mini statements.
- [Micro ATM Services](https://gatexpay.com/services/micro-atm-services): Portable card-swipe terminals, cash withdrawal, and debit transactions.
- [Money Transfer Services](https://gatexpay.com/services/money-transfer-services): Domestic money transfer (DMT), IMPS, NEFT, and RTGS payment rails.

## Commerce & Business Solutions
- [E-Commerce Services](https://gatexpay.com/services/e-commerce-services): Storefront optimization, inventory workflows, marketing, and commerce integrations.
- [E-Commerce Solutions](https://gatexpay.com/services/e-commerce-solutions): End-to-end online store architecture, custom checkout, and scalable retail systems.
- [Web & App Development](https://gatexpay.com/services/web-app-development): Scalable web applications, mobile platforms, and digital fintech software.
- [Digital Marketing Services](https://gatexpay.com/services/digital-marketing-services): Performance marketing, SEO, paid media, and brand growth.

## Citizen & Utility Services
- [PAN Card Services](https://gatexpay.com/services/pan-card-services): UTI/NSDL authorized PAN verification, application, and correction workflows.
- [Bill Payment Services](https://gatexpay.com/services/bill-payment-services): BBPS-integrated utility bill payments, electricity, water, gas, and fastag.
- [Recharge Services](https://gatexpay.com/services/recharge-services): Real-time prepaid and postpaid mobile and DTH recharge APIs.
- [Travel & Booking Services](https://gatexpay.com/services/travel-services): Flight, train, bus, and hotel reservation APIs.
- [E-Governance Services](https://gatexpay.com/services/e-governance-services): Citizen service delivery and digital government portal integrations.
